description: Confirm Mlr1/Mlr2 identity as Lcor/Lcorl and contrast HTH classification evidence for NOL4 vs its partners
code:
import requests, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
for acc,lab in [("Q6ZPI3","mouse Lcor"),("Q3U285","mouse Lcorl"),("Q96JN0","human LCOR"),("Q8N3X6","human LCORL")]:
    j=S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()
    pd_=j['proteinDescription']
    alts=[a.get('fullName',{}).get('value') for a in pd_.get('alternativeNames',[])]
    gns=[]
    for g in j.get('genes',[]):
        gns.append(g.get('geneName',{}).get('value'))
        gns+=[s['value'] for s in g.get('synonyms',[])]
    print(f"{lab} ({acc}): genes={gns}")
    print(f"   alt names: {alts}")
    g=S.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
            params={"geneProductId":f"UniProtKB:{acc}","limit":60,"goId":"GO:0003677,GO:0000981,GO:0003700"},
            headers={"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=90).json()
    print(f"   DNA-binding GO annotations: {g.get('numberOfHits')} ->",
          sorted({(a['goId'],a['goEvidence']) for a in g.get('results',[])}))

# ---------- FIGURE: database-classification contrast ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,6.4)); ax.axis('off')
rows=[
 ["CATH-Gene3D structural superfamily","G3DSA:1.10.10.60 Homeodomain-like","none assigned anywhere in 638 aa"],
 ["SUPERFAMILY (SCOP) assignment","SSF46689 Homeodomain-like","none assigned anywhere in 638 aa"],
 ["InterPro homologous superfamily","IPR009057 Homeodomain-like superfamily","none (relations = [], overlaps = [])"],
 ["InterPro domain name","IPR007889 'DNA binding HTH domain, Psq-type'","IPR056549 'Nucleolar protein 4, helical domain'"],
 ["InterPro domain description","-","'predicted to form an alpha-helical bundle'"],
 ["GO term attached to the InterPro entry","GO:0003677 DNA binding","none"],
 ["PROSITE profile","PS50960 Psq-type HTH domain profile","none"],
 ["Pfam","PF05225 helix-turn-helix, Psq domain","PF23079 'Nucleolar protein 4, helical'"],
 ["UniProt keyword","DNA-binding / nucleus","Alternative splicing, Nucleus only"],
 ["Foldseek vs PDB100 (full protein)","-","2 hits, best E = 6.8, none significant"],
 ["Calibrated HTH geometry test","1-3 HTH-like helix pairs","0 HTH-like helix pairs"],
]
t=ax.table(cellText=[[a,b,c] for a,b,c in rows],
           colLabels=["Classification evidence","True HTH control\n(Mblk-1 family: mbr-1 / LCOR / LCORL)","NOL4 (O94818)"],
           loc='center',cellLoc='left',colWidths=[0.30,0.35,0.35])
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(8.3); t.scale(1,1.85)
for j_ in range(3): t[0,j_].set_facecolor('#2d3748'); t[0,j_].set_text_props(color='w',weight='bold')
for i in range(1,len(rows)+1):
    t[i,0].set_facecolor('#edf2f7'); t[i,1].set_facecolor('#c6f6d5'); t[i,2].set_facecolor('#fed7d7')
ax.set_title("Every structure-based classification resource that models the HTH fold assigns it to NOL4's partners, and nothing to NOL4\n"
 "NOL4 interacts with Mlr1/Mlr2 (mouse Mblk-1 homologs; the only mouse Psq-HTH proteins are Lcor and Lcorl), which supply the DNA-binding HTH",
 fontsize=10.5,pad=16)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
